g.text: Annual education spending on a student (Rs)
Weighted median education spending is Rs 9,500; the top 10% exceed Rs 39,000
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files (course data repository).
Sample: 1,061 students with annual education spending above zero in KP urban; 1 student outside Rs 100-Rs 1,000,000 is excluded.
Weighted by the household weight (hhweight). Bins are 0.1 log10 units wide.
